audit.whatIsWrong: The page (both layers) already correctly treats Chronoshift as a revive/death-delay, not untargetability — breakdown.cooldowns says "the revive undoes your kill" and content mid/late explicitly say "Chronoshift only delays a death, it doesn't prevent it."
audit.why: Chronoshift's flags carry "untargetable", which contradicts Riot's own description ("teleporting the champion back in time if they take lethal damage" — a death-prevention rune, not an untargetable state). This is a tooltip-parsing flag misfire; the page correctly followed the description instead.
audit.corrected: No correction needed to the interaction itself; added the real 120/90/60s cooldown number to the two places that name Chronoshift as matchup-defining without a number.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns and report[5] (Key Ability Interactions) call Chronoshift matchup-defining but never state its actual cooldown.
audit.why: Kit gives real per-rank cooldown 120/90/60s (rank 1 is a long 2-minute window worth naming).
audit.corrected: Added "(120s at rank 1)" to both fields.
